# Avlys AI

> Avlys AI is an AI-native product studio and enterprise engineering partner.
> We design, build, and evolve custom platforms, internal tools, and intelligent
> applications from discovery through deployment and support. Our team is based
> in Hyderabad and Bengaluru, India, and works with Indian and global clients.

## Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://avlysai.com/services/custom-software-development): enterprise platforms, internal tools, marketplaces, and customer applications, from product discovery through launch and support.
- [AI Agent Development](https://avlysai.com/services/ai-agents): support, sales, and voice agents with human-in-the-loop orchestration.
- [AI Automation](https://avlysai.com/services/ai-automation): lead response, support triage, and document processing wired into existing tools.
- [AI Integration](https://avlysai.com/services/ai-integration): RAG, copilots, document pipelines, and controlled connections to existing applications and data.
- [Enterprise AI Consulting](https://avlysai.com/services/enterprise-ai-consulting): readiness assessment, use-case ranking, and a costed pilot plan.
- [Data Collection & Preparation](https://avlysai.com/services/ai-training-data): collection, annotation, cleaning, and evaluation sets scoped to the model task and agreed handling terms.

## Avlys Data

Avlys Data is the AI training-data service from Avlys AI: off-the-shelf collection options, custom collection, preparation and annotation. Data project timing, availability and pricing are confirmed for the brief; software delivery estimates do not apply automatically to data work.

- [Avlys Data](https://avlysai.com/data): service overview, collection catalogue, pilot process, delivery checklist and buyer FAQs.
- [Image training data](https://avlysai.com/data/image): captioned photographs, satellite imagery, apparel, synthetic visual reasoning, characters and cultural/scientific imagery.
- [Audio training data](https://avlysai.com/data/audio): multilingual and Indian-language speech, read speech, audiobooks and voice commands.
- [Video training data](https://avlysai.com/data/video): robot demonstrations, manipulation trajectories and synthetic multi-view scenes. Human egocentric capture is a separately scoped pilot.
- [Request sample availability and pricing](https://avlysai.com/data#data-brief): share the task, format, coverage, approximate volume and timeline. Email: sales@avlysai.com. Phone: +91 99377 30039.

The catalogue provides descriptions, not downloadable datasets or confirmed stock. Avlys OTS Data includes third-party and public research collections with Avlys sourcing and preparation services; the Avlys label does not establish ownership of underlying material. Sizes describe reference collections. Availability, applicable usage terms, preparation and delivery scope are confirmed before supply.
